style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#334155;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1452" y="114.5" width="229.82" height="90.45" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#334155;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1452" y="304.5" width="276.94" height="102.8" SW2B<br>J3 2-pos OUT 1: 12V_ARMED (F2), GND_P<br> → CDI POWER +<br>J4 2-pos OUT 2: spare / aux (F2), GND_P<br>J5 3-pos CDI: TRIG+, SHUT DOWN, GND_P<br>J6 2-pos CH-R2 DUT: DUT+, DUT−<br>J7 2-pos CH-PU pickup: IN+, IN−<br>J8 2×8 header: expansion (3V3, GND_L,<br> SDA, SCL, GP1, GP8–GP12, GP16,<br> GP21, VSYS)<br>JP1 1×3 mux VDD (12V_ARMED / U12)<br>JC1, JC2 1×3 sockets: plug-in clamp<br> modules svg.title: Mainboard integration sheet

text.tspan: Pico 2 W socket, the two I/O expanders and the ADS1115, with the block they feed. Blocks: CH-R2 (ch-r2-pcb.md), CH-PU (ch-pu-pickup.md), ARM stage (power-arm.md), CH-TG (ch-tg-trigger.md). Same-named nets are connected.
(PD) = 10 kΩ pull-down, (PU) = 10 kΩ pull-up, (hi-Z) = no pull.
These are the safe states of every line when the expander is reset.
Firmware pulses EXP_RESET first at boot, so the outputs return to
these defaults. Left column = port B (pins 1–8), right = port A.
the fallback for the 0.5 mm package.
bus to the 12 V power side.
100 nF at every IC supply pin.
J5 3-pos CDI: TRIG+, SHUT DOWN, GND_P
Right: 12 V power domain (GND_P): J1–J5, ARM
Between: isolation slot ≥ 2 mm, no copper
crossing; only the optocouplers, photoMOS and
AGND star point at the Pico AGND pin (33);
DUT− and the CH-PU clamp return go there.

⚠ Low-voltage logic side only. The CDI makes 200–400 V and the ignition coil makes kV outside this board. Never connect J6 / J7 to a CDI output, a spinning pickup (J6) or an ignition coil. See docs/safety.md.
